verdict.rationale: The evidence only shows a browser-based TOTP toolset (docs-4, docs-6) and Entra ID seed export, unrelated to the FIDO2 security key itself carrying TOTP/HOTP slots or challenge-response capability; no documentation shows the hardware key supports legacy OTP protocols. Missing for 10: any spec sheet or docs stating the key itself implements TOTP/HOTP slots, challenge-response mode, or dual-protocol firmware.
